risk_if_not_implemented: Without Notice of Embedded Sensor Data Collection, embedded and IoT technologies may operate with unknown, insecure or unmonitored configurations, creating exploitable footholds. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Statutory / Regulatory / Contractual Change (MT-11).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Notice of Collection (CFG-18.2) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Embedded Sensor Capability
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to configure embedded sensors on systems to: 
(1) Prohibit the remote activation of sensing capabilities; and
(2) Provide an explicit indication of sensor use to users.
compensating_control_2.justification: Embedded Sensor Capability (CFG-18) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Notice of Collection (CFG-18.2) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
